column3: Close to the Hebrew; “comforters of trouble” is rendered “Miserable comforters.”
Close to the Hebrew; וַתִּקְמְטֵנִי (“you have seized/shriveled me”) is rendered “You have shriveled me up.”
Close to the Hebrew; וַיִּשְׂטְמֵנִי (“bears a grudge against me”) is rendered “hates me,” and “my opponent” is capitalized as God, “His gaze.”
Close to the Hebrew; כִּלְיוֹתַי (“my kidneys”) is rendered “my heart.”
Close to the Hebrew; “breach upon breach” is rendered “wound upon wound.”
Close to the Hebrew; קַרְנִי (“my horn,” strength) is rendered “my head.”
Close to the Hebrew; צַלְמָוֶת (“deep darkness”) is rendered “the shadow of death.”
Close to the Hebrew; “and a son of man for his companion” is rendered “As a man pleads for his neighbor.”
Close to the Hebrew; “years of number” is rendered “a few years.”
